question: What act of transmission is claimed by the speaker in addressing Bhairavī with respect to the practice of the soul?
premises: This practice of the soul is designated.
It has been told to the addressee.
The statement is addressed to Bhairavī.
inference: The speaker has now transmitted the practice of the soul to Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The full content of that practice is not detailed in this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
